Undercurrents of tube draw liquids to each receptacle, condensing towards an end-point where an injector is primed for loading. This end provides a terminal where one can flirt with world-ending genomimetic scaffolding.

A tether rides them back to its apex, where they drop again--the cycle repeating without stop. All behind a stiff glazed barrier, where digits sprawl to count the multiple relays each orb makes. Occasionally, the machine cries with a mechanical voice 'banzai!

part.Name: Description
part.Short: The distended jaw of this leviathian bears many hooked teeth, shaped unlike the vinereavers a farmer might bare.

part.Name: Description
part.Short: Maybe this is what a madpole is to become, a vicious beast of gargantuan size, jaws lined with thousands of teeth shimmering as it hones in on any sign of life around it.

part.Name: Description
part.Short: A dark shadow envelopes this massive serpent, an eerie silence moves with it as you catch its faint appearance here and there, diving between planes of water and void.

part.Name: Description
part.Short: Great wings of cartilage flit on the ocean current in slow methodical motions, its edges glow with luminescence.

part.Name: Description
part.Short: A gargantuan maw is forever agape, as the monolith drifts through the open ocean, food filters through its countless baleen hairs, while fluids are ejected from siphons on the creature's pectoral main-line.

part.Name: Description
part.Short: Following the leviathan's maw are undulating, bioluminescent shafts of ribbed-muscles and dorsal fins.

part.Name: Description
part.Short: Worn chrome was stained for countless millennia by salt-scuffed tears marking supple cheeks of a lonely eater, their mind now lost in the digital void. Yet this visage remains, a relic of the one who was entombed within their own synthetic shell.

part.Name: Description
part.Short: A chrome bed-pipe, with holes drilled into its upper-end, one side is pinched into a mouth-piece, the other widened into a foot-joint.

part.Name: Description
part.Short: The blade erupts from the fore-arm like a mantis' arm curling forward toward its prey, it extends over the fist and and hisses as nanites ready to evolve its current structure.

part.Name: Description
part.Short: A neo-plastic grip, supports a chrome box-head, the barrel hides inside, ratcheting several rounds before releasing them in a quick burst.

part.Name: Description
part.Short: Long synthetic frames collapse on a horizontal center, a beam of energy sparks between them as the weapon charges. From the grip, the trigger releases. A volley of destructive radiation rips through the air converging on a single point with deadly accuracy.

part.Name: Description
part.Short: A burning flame of amber floats below a psychic wick. This one seems temperamental.

part.Name: Description
part.Short: Colorless, imposing a crisp outline of vanta-black that curls space into streams, like magma currents snaking into lava-ways.

part.Name: Description
part.Short: Coils of electricity hug a spiralling cacophony of radioactive waves.

part.Name: Description
part.Short: A tool necessary to retain even an ounce of sanity while trapped in this abyss for millenniums untold. It's slick to the touch and stands boldly despite its wear. Crenulated with countless waves like scintillating ripples on a spectrographic display.

part.Name: Description
part.Short: A small, clear, glass-casket engulfs a singularity, pulses of dark energy feed into a amplifier and then sends power through its surges.

part.Name: Description
part.Short: The sorrowful gaze of this metallic-flaked, silver-mask depicts a moon whose harrowing expression speaks one truth: of all the celestials, the moon glares with misfortune. Forever bound to watch this twisted plane, and all its suffering.

part.Name: Description
part.Short: A bleached shawl, an echo of a once astute and revenant importance.

part.Name: Description
part.Short: With a deep gasp, the earth breathes sulfurous fumes into open air.

part.Name: Description
part.Short: A large jungle mangrove, ample fruits of hexagonal majesty shimmer in the dim light of the brimstone waste.

part.Name: Description
part.Short: This fruit reeks of a old nits, odorous in smell--but succulent in taste.

part.Name: Description
part.Short: Grinded in mortar, the tender meat is pulped and aged with sugar and salt, it takes on a gooey form spreadable on breads and flesh with a pungent and wild taste.

part.Name: Description

part.Name: Description
part.Short: This fruit reeks of a old nits, odorous in smell--but succulent in taste.

part.Name: Description

The many it has decimated leave its edge stained; scales, fur and even fulcrum-nanites embedded into its core. Hardened by blood and chipped bones, the marring-great cleaver slays without mercy, determined to feed on defeated it culls in the moment. Just like its previous master.
